args.subject: Invitation: Tuesday Evening Book Club (7:00 PM)
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I’d like to invite you to our book club meetings on Tuesday evenings. We meet at 7:00 PM at the local library and are currently reading mystery novels. We’d love to have you join us.

Please let me know if you can make it.

Thanks,

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery downtown
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM, so if you go early you’ll get the best loaves.

Thought you might enjoy it!

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Invitation: Hands‑on Italian Cooking Class — Wednesday Evening
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I’d like to invite you to a hands-on Italian cuisine cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week. It’s on Wednesday evening (next Wednesday). The class is a practical, hands-on session where we’ll learn classic Italian techniques and recipes — a great chance to cook together and enjoy what we make.

Would you be able to join? Please let me know and I can share any additional details.

Thanks,

args.subject: Recommendation: Rachel — Yoga Instructor
args.body:
Hi Charlie,

I wanted to recommend Rachel — she's an excellent yoga instructor who teaches at the community center on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Her classes are well-paced and suitable for all levels. I’ve found them very helpful for improving flexibility and reducing stress.

If you’d like, I can share her contact details or the class schedule.

Best regards,

args.subject: Invitation: Book Club — Tuesdays at 7 PM
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I’d like to invite you to our book club meetings on Tuesday evenings at 7:00 PM at the local library. We’re currently reading mystery novels and would love for you to join us.

Please let me know if you can make it.

Thanks!
